output:
To: timeline:jo.vasquez.ink
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: none

ok I have to vent about this because I am genuinely pissed.

a sticker shop called StickerBurrow Co is selling my switchblade moth. they call it the "Knife Moth Vinyl Decal," $6.50 a piece or 3 for $15. same crack in the blade. same wing pattern. they didnt even flip it. thats not "inspired by," thats not a similar moth, thats not a silhouette with the same vibe. thats a straight scan of my linework, printed and cut and sold.

heres the timeline so everyone can see it. I drew the moth for my sept 13 flash day and I posted the whole sheet on aug 30 (go look at it, its the one with the switchblade). flash day came and the moth went in the FIRST HOUR. one person, one tattoo, one payment. thats the entire deal. a flash piece is sold ONE time to ONE person, and that person paid for it, and now its on her body for the rest of her life. that IS what she bought. the whole sheet was $120-$180 a piece, I drew the thing at my kitchen table over three weekends.

and then tonight one of my clients messaged me asking if I was the one selling stickers of her tattoo. her tattoo. the one I drew. she genuinely thought it was me putting my own art on a water bottle for $6.50. I know who she is and im not putting her on blast here, but if youve had a piece of mine from that day and youve been wondering, no. it wasnt me. I dont sell stickers, I dont sell my flash drawings to anybody, I dont make vinyl of anything, ever.

so I messaged the shop like a normal person. asked them to take the listing down, told them I had the original drawing and the aug 30 post. their reply was "love your work!" and then "moths are a very common tattoo motif and we can't remove listings based on similarity alone" and then they told me to send a REGISTERED COPYRIGHT through their support form. a registered copyright. for a moth with a switchblade that I drew at my kitchen table. like I have an attorney on retainer with the certificate already printed out. cool. cool cool cool.

what makes me the most mad is they know exactly what they did. "love your work" is not an accident. they found my sheet, they picked my file, they traced it, they priced it, they put it up. then when I asked nicely they handed me a legal form and told me to pound sand with it. because thats how it works. small shops dont have lawyer money, and tattoo shops especially dont, so these sticker places know a one person shop is not gonna drop 400 bucks an hour on a copyright attorney over a six dollar decal. so they just dont care.

what I want from you guys: please report the listing wherever its posted, every report pushes it down and its how they end up taking stuff down. and dont buy from them while its up. if youve had a piece of mine done, please dont buy my drawing off a sticker site. I dont make money that way and honestly a piece of mine means more to me than a decal does.

anyway. thats the whole thing. still mad. gonna go stare at my wall and think about it.
